answer: Each epoch the network issues a bridge challenge: an AI falcon must navigate a procedurally generated maze lit by a lantern of random logical predicates, outputting a proof that only a model with fresh compute can produce. The verifier hashes the challenge seed, so reused solutions fail, forcing a sybil to spend fresh GPU cycles for every identity. The attack cost grows linearly with the number of fake agents, making large‑scale impersonation economically prohibitive.
